name: std-agent-session
description: std-agent-session — the persisted conversation with an in-app assistant. Owns AgentMessage rows (role, content, ownerId stamped with the real @user, createdAt). SEND stores the user's message, reloads the thread and emits CONVERSE with the whole conversation, oldest first, for std-agent-tool-loop to answer; REPLIED stores the assistant's reply and redraws; REPLY_FAILED redraws the conversation (the tool loop shows the error). Rows are meant to be private to their owner: owner-scoped access needs an [identity] roster, so the binding organism declares the @read/@create scoping on AgentMessage — this generic atom cannot.
